results.title: Gemini separates history from AI training but keeps chats longer - Notebookcheck News
results.description: Steffen Zahn (translated by Steffen Zahn), Published 11/17/2026 🇩🇪 ... Google is changing how privacy works in the Gemini app. Until now, a single setting called Keep Activity decided both how long your chats were saved and whether Google could use them to train its AI models. Anyone who wanted to keep their history had to accept training as well. That is about to change, as 9to5Google first reported. Google updated its Gemini Apps Privacy Hub on November 16, and the page already describes the new split.
